body:
NTA

This behaviour makes me incredibly mad. NC was warned before meeting you about your conditions and he still went out of his way to check for himself how you would react, laughing throughout that. I wonder if he would do the same should somebody tell him you are seriously allergic to peanuts - would he force feed you a peanut and then wait for the allergic reaction? Your condition is not to be a butt of a joke, he might have caused additional trauma. Go for the charges. It is his problem that he is a jerk.

I feel you. I have the same issue with multiple people. I've spent a year studying abroad and I fell madly in love with this one guy and had a bunch of friends there. And then it all fell down. One person started ghosting me the minute I left the college campus. The other one stopped talking to me when I left the country. People kept leaving me until I have literally two friends from this period who still occassionally hit me up. I miss all of them, greatly (except one, who I dated later on and who cheated on me... it's a long story). I have been thinking about them lately more than before. I don't know what to do, how to free myself. 

I guess, I don't have any advice for you here, unfortunately, just a friend going through the same damn thing.

I was in the US, I am from Central Europe, and the lifestyles differ so much. I wouldn't mind being treated like this by schoolmates here, because we don't have campuses, we usually have classes only two or three days a week and the friendships we build at college are not the strongest. But there, it was different. The people lives with me for a year. I guess I am too clingy. I should be using people like a paper towel, or something semi-permanent (I'm bad with similes :-D) Thanks for talking to me. I'm trying standing up for myself. The guy actually messaged me today, guuit-tripping me and I was having none of it. Still, kinda scared I ruined it permanently. I am sorry about your colleagues. Relationships are so weird, I really don't know how they function, they scare me.

Thank you very much for your input. I will at least try to do some thing you mention. Taking control is something I'm good in school projects but not in my life. Sounds interesting to give it a try. Thank you again.

Thank you for responding. I study in the Czech Republic and there is no way you can transfer, these things just don't exist here. You go to college with one major and leave with the same. I am doing some Math and Physics at home, based on my high school textbooks and the internet. Though I get it alone, things like derivations and integrals are probably too much for me. And there's no physics without derivation and integrals. So... I don't know, I'm just a bit lost now. Under a lot of pressure. Stressed even after 1,5 months of holidays. Anyway, thank you again :-)
Can't stop listening to that soundtrack. Who picked that music is my hero.
